// Decode pump.fun BondingCurve + Global accounts from a public Solana RPC and cross-check
// against PumpPortal subscribeNewToken events.
// Usage: node decode_bonding_curve.mjs <ws_log.jsonl> <out.json> [extraMint ...]
// Layout source: github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs idl/pump.json (refreshed 2026-09-12).
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { PublicKey } from '@solana/web3.js';

const RPC = 'https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com';
const PUMP_PROGRAM = new PublicKey('6EF8rrecthR5Dkzon8Nwu78hRvfCKubJ14M5uBEwF6P');
const GLOBAL = new PublicKey('4wTV1YmiEkRvAtNtsSGPtUrqRYQMe5SKy2uB4Jjaxnjf');
const BC_DISC = [23, 183, 248, 55, 96, 216, 172, 96]; // anchor discriminator "account:BondingCurve"
const GLOBAL_DISC = [167, 232, 232, 177, 200, 108, 114, 127];
const TOKEN_DECIMALS = 6; // pump.fun mints always use 6 decimals
const LAMPORTS = 1e9;

const [logPath, outPath, ...extraMints] = process.argv.slice(2);

// ---------- helpers ----------
const headersSeen = [];
async function rpc(method, params) {
  const res = await fetch(RPC, {
    method: 'POST',
    // NOTE: no Origin header. The public endpoint answers HTTP 403 {"code":403,"message":"Access forbidden"}
    // when a browser Origin (e.g. https://www.orbytai.org) is sent -> call it server-side only.
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method, params }),
  });
  const h = {};
  for (const k of ['access-control-allow-origin', 'x-ratelimit-method-limit', 'x-ratelimit-method-remaining',
    'x-ratelimit-rps-limit', 'x-ratelimit-rps-remaining', 'x-ratelimit-conn-limit', 'x-ratelimit-conn-remaining',
    'retry-after', 'cache-control']) if (res.headers.get(k) != null) h[k] = res.headers.get(k);
  headersSeen.push({ method, status: res.status, headers: h });
  const j = await res.json();
  if (j.error) throw new Error(method + ' ' + JSON.stringify(j.error));
  return j.result;
}

class Reader {
  constructor(buf) { this.b = buf; this.o = 0; }
  left() { return this.b.length - this.o; }
  u8() { return this.b.readUInt8(this.o++); }
  bool() { return this.u8() !== 0; }
  u16() { const v = this.b.readUInt16LE(this.o); this.o += 2; return v; }
  u64() { const v = this.b.readBigUInt64LE(this.o); this.o += 8; return v; }
  i128() { const lo = this.b.readBigUInt64LE(this.o); const hi = this.b.readBigInt64LE(this.o + 8); this.o += 16; return (hi << 64n) + lo; }
  pk() { const v = new PublicKey(this.b.subarray(this.o, this.o + 32)).toBase58(); this.o += 32; return v; }
}

// Appended fields: accounts written before an upgrade are shorter -> missing trailing fields read as default.
function decodeBondingCurve(buf) {
  const disc = [...buf.subarray(0, 8)];
  if (disc.join() !== BC_DISC.join()) throw new Error('not a BondingCurve account: ' + disc);
  const r = new Reader(buf); r.o = 8;
  const out = {
    virtual_token_reserves: r.u64(),
    virtual_quote_reserves: r.u64(), // formerly virtual_sol_reserves (lamports for SOL-paired coins)
    real_token_reserves: r.u64(),
    real_quote_reserves: r.u64(),    // formerly real_sol_reserves
    token_total_supply: r.u64(),
    complete: r.bool(),
  };
  const opt = [
    ['creator', 'pk', 32], ['is_mayhem_mode', 'bool', 1], ['is_cashback_coin', 'bool', 1],
    ['quote_mint', 'pk', 32], ['creator_fee_bps', 'u64', 8], ['can_edit_creator_fee', 'bool', 1],
    ['is_holder_reward', 'bool', 1],
  ];
  for (const [name, type, size] of opt) {
    if (r.left() < size) { out[name] = null; continue; } // field not present on this (older/shorter) account
    out[name] = r[type]();
  }
  out._account_data_len = buf.length;
  out._decoded_bytes = r.o;
  return out;
}

function decodeGlobal(buf) {
  const disc = [...buf.subarray(0, 8)];
  if (disc.join() !== GLOBAL_DISC.join()) throw new Error('not Global');
  const r = new Reader(buf); r.o = 8;
  return {
    initialized: r.bool(), authority: r.pk(), fee_recipient: r.pk(),
    initial_virtual_token_reserves: r.u64(), initial_virtual_sol_reserves: r.u64(),
    initial_real_token_reserves: r.u64(), token_total_supply: r.u64(), fee_basis_points: r.u64(),
    withdraw_authority: r.pk(), enable_migrate: r.bool(), pool_migration_fee: r.u64(),
    creator_fee_basis_points: r.u64(),
    fee_recipients_count: (r.o += 32 * 7, 7),
    set_creator_authority: r.pk(), admin_set_creator_authority: r.pk(), create_v2_enabled: r.bool(),
    whitelist_pda: r.pk(), reserved_fee_recipient: r.pk(), mayhem_mode_enabled: r.bool(),
    reserved_fee_recipients_count: (r.o += 32 * 7, 7), is_cashback_enabled: r.bool(),
    buyback_fee_recipients_count: (r.o += 32 * 8, 8), buyback_basis_points: r.u64(),
    initial_virtual_quote_reserves: r.u64(),
    _account_data_len: buf.length,
  };
}

// Derived metrics (all math in BigInt until the final display conversion).
function derive(bc, initialRealTokenReserves) {
  const vT = bc.virtual_token_reserves, vQ = bc.virtual_quote_reserves;
  const priceSolPerToken = (Number(vQ) / LAMPORTS) / (Number(vT) / 10 ** TOKEN_DECIMALS);
  // pump SDK bondingCurveMarketCap(): virtualSolReserves * mintSupply / virtualTokenReserves (lamports)
  const mcapLamports = vT === 0n ? null : (vQ * bc.token_total_supply) / vT;
  // Bonding progress used by pump.fun-style UIs: share of the initial REAL token reserves already sold.
  const sold = initialRealTokenReserves - bc.real_token_reserves;
  const progressBps = bc.complete ? 10000n : (sold * 10000n) / initialRealTokenReserves;
  return {
    price_sol_per_token: priceSolPerToken,
    market_cap_sol: mcapLamports == null ? null : Number(mcapLamports) / LAMPORTS,
    real_sol_in_curve: Number(bc.real_quote_reserves) / LAMPORTS,
    tokens_left_for_sale_ui: Number(bc.real_token_reserves) / 10 ** TOKEN_DECIMALS,
    bonding_progress_pct: Number(progressBps) / 100,
  };
}

const jsonSafe = (o) => JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(o, (_, v) => (typeof v === 'bigint' ? v.toString() : v)));

// ---------- main ----------
const log = readFileSync(logPath, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map(JSON.parse);
const creates = log.filter((e) => e.dir === 'in' && e.data?.txType === 'create' && e.data.pool === 'pump').map((e) => e.data);
const migrates = log.filter((e) => e.dir === 'in' && e.data?.txType === 'migrate').map((e) => e.data);
const byMint = Object.fromEntries(creates.map((c) => [c.mint, c]));

// primary: most recent regular create with a name; plus a mayhem coin, plus migrated mints
const primary = [...creates].reverse().find((c) => c.name && !c.is_mayhem_mode);
const mayhem = [...creates].reverse().find((c) => c.is_mayhem_mode);
const mints = [...new Set([primary?.mint, mayhem?.mint, ...migrates.map((m) => m.mint), ...extraMints].filter(Boolean))];

const globalInfo = await rpc('getAccountInfo', [GLOBAL.toBase58(), { encoding: 'base64', commitment: 'confirmed' }]);
const global = decodeGlobal(Buffer.from(globalInfo.value.data[0], 'base64'));
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));

const pdas = mints.map((m) => PublicKey.findProgramAddressSync([Buffer.from('bonding-curve'), new PublicKey(m).toBuffer()], PUMP_PROGRAM)[0]);

// single getAccountInfo for the primary (as a raw sample), getMultipleAccounts for the rest
const primaryRaw = await rpc('getAccountInfo', [pdas[0].toBase58(), { encoding: 'base64', commitment: 'confirmed' }]);
await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400));
const multi = await rpc('getMultipleAccounts', [pdas.map((p) => p.toBase58()), { encoding: 'base64', commitment: 'confirmed' }]);

const results = mints.map((mint, i) => {
  const acc = i === 0 ? primaryRaw.value : multi.value[i];
  const stream = byMint[mint] || null;
  const res = { mint, bonding_curve_pda: pdas[i].toBase58(), stream_bondingCurveKey: stream?.bondingCurveKey ?? null,
    pda_matches_stream: stream ? stream.bondingCurveKey === pdas[i].toBase58() : null };
  if (!acc) { res.account = null; return res; }
  res.account_owner = acc.owner; res.account_lamports = acc.lamports;
  const bc = decodeBondingCurve(Buffer.from(acc.data[0], 'base64'));
  res.decoded = bc;
  res.derived = derive(bc, global.initial_real_token_reserves);
  if (stream) {
    res.stream_at_create = { vTokensInBondingCurve: stream.vTokensInBondingCurve, vSolInBondingCurve: stream.vSolInBondingCurve,
      marketCapSol: stream.marketCapSol, is_mayhem_mode: stream.is_mayhem_mode };
    res.onchain_ui_now = { vTokens_ui: Number(bc.virtual_token_reserves) / 1e6, vSol_ui: Number(bc.virtual_quote_reserves) / 1e9 };
    res.stream_marketCapSol_formula_check = stream.vSolInBondingCurve / stream.vTokensInBondingCurve * (Number(bc.token_total_supply) / 1e6);
  }
  return res;
});

const out = jsonSafe({
  _note: 'REAL mainnet data fetched ' + new Date().toISOString() + ' from ' + RPC + ' (getAccountInfo/getMultipleAccounts, base64, commitment confirmed). Decoded with pump IDL layout. u64 values are raw integers as strings: token amounts have 6 decimals, quote (SOL) amounts are lamports (9 decimals).',
  rpc_response_headers: headersSeen,
  global_account: { address: GLOBAL.toBase58(), decoded: global },
  primary_raw_getAccountInfo_value: primaryRaw.value,
  bonding_curves: results,
});
writeFileSync(outPath, JSON.stringify(out, null, 2));
console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 2).slice(0, 9000));
